1: A plague of locusts strips the land. Joel calls priests and people to fast and cry to God.
Disaster is read as a call to turn back.
2: An army darkens the day of the Lord. "Return to me with all your heart; rend your hearts and not your garments." God promises, "I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh."
Read on Ash Wednesday. Peter quotes the promise at Pentecost.
3: God gathers the nations for judgement. Zion will be safe, and the mountains will drip sweet wine.
God is a refuge for his people.
